Security/compliance: enterprise legal customers require SSO (SAML), KMS integration, detailed audit logs, and contractual data residency guarantees. Legal team sent preliminary DPA with retention/erasure clauses (redlines in Drive doc).

Notes style: shorthand, action items, questions in-thread. See linked Drive for pricing and security docs.
